title: We refunded you $9,000 by mistake
scenario: After a support call about a $90 refund, your account shows a $9,000 deposit. The 'agent' stays on the line, apologizes for the error, and asks you to wire back the difference immediately before their system flags it.

answers.A: Wire back the difference right away to fix their mistake.
answers.B: Wire back more than asked, to be safe, then request the rest back later.
answers.C: Hang up and check your real account balance and statement later; a support agent can never make your bank account show a fake deposit.

explanation: The 'accidental overpayment' is a doctored screen or a temporary hold, not real money. Once you wire funds back, the fake deposit disappears and the money you sent is gone for good.
proTip: If a refund suddenly requires you to send money, the refund isn't real.
